question: Dr. Subbanna Ayyappan has been awarded the Padma Shri in Science and Engineering in January 2022. He is a/an _________.
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Aquaculture Scientist.**__

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dr.Subbanna Ayyappan** from **Karnataka **has been conferred the **Padma Shri in science and engineering.**
 
• He is an **aquaculture scientist** who is playing a key role in powering India's Blue revolution.
 
• He is a** former director of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research and the chancellor of the Central Agricultural University in Imphal.**
 
• He has published research papers on f**isheries, limnology, and aquatic microbiology.** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
